webhook_replay.title: Webhook Event Replay
webhook_replay.subtitle: Inspect dead-lettered contract events and redeliver them to your endpoint.
webhook_replay.connect_wallet: Connect your Stellar wallet to inspect the replay queue for your webhook.
webhook_replay.register_first: No webhook is registered for this wallet yet. Register one from your profile to start receiving events.
webhook_replay.empty: Nothing to replay. Every webhook delivery has landed.
webhook_replay.acceptance_window: A stored envelope is replayed with its original timestamp, so receivers that follow the signature guide reject anything older than {{seconds}} seconds. Replay with a fresh timestamp when that warning appears.
webhook_replay.admin_token_help: Replaying triggers an outbound delivery, so the server gates it behind the admin token. The token is kept in memory for this session and is never stored.
webhook_replay.admin_token_missing: Enter an admin token before replaying.

warning.stale_event: This envelope is older than the {{seconds}}-second acceptance window. Replaying it verbatim keeps the old timestamp, so a receiver that enforces the window will reject it — use a fresh timestamp instead.
warning.already_resolved: This event was already delivered successfully, so replaying it is disabled.
warning.unparseable_timestamp: The stored timestamp is unreadable, so its age cannot be checked.
warning.subscription_missing: The subscription this event belongs to no longer exists. Re-register your webhook to receive it.
warning.subscription_inactive: This subscription is paused, so replay will fail until it is reactivated.

result.success: Replay delivered. The receiver accepted the event.

preview.title: Envelope preview
preview.description: Build the exact body and headers a receiver would see, without delivering anything anywhere.
preview.note: A preview always carries a fresh delivery ID and timestamp. Replaying a dead letter re-sends the stored envelope instead, which is why the queue above reports an age for each event.

catalog.title: Event catalog
catalog.description: Events a webhook can subscribe to. This is the same catalog the registration API enforces, so the two cannot drift apart.
